g.text: Each link uses two recording pairs, one control pair and a Reserved pair. Bank 226 serves the single J201 link.

g.text: MC1/MC2 all 80 pins each pass through; selected Bank-226 data and five Bank-67 GPIO isolate lower BRK contacts.
